context.roleEssence: This is a senior IC role owning the infrastructure and deployment backbone of Veridian's platform - building and hardening the systems that make reliability, deployment frequency, and security posture possible. Day-to-day work centers on infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring/observability, and incident response, done in close coordination with the immediate Infra & DevOps team and cross-functional engineering partners whose services run on this infrastructure. At IC4, expertise means not just executing but leading complex workstreams and mentoring others, so ramp-up needs to cover both the technical estate and how the team operates as a unit.

onboardingNeeds.title: Map the current infrastructure and deployment architecture
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence centers on owning infrastructure and deployment systems - a senior engineer needs a working mental model of the actual architecture (environments, CI/CD pipelines, cloud topology) before contributing meaningfully or mentoring others on it.

onboardingNeeds.title: Learn incident response and on-call practices
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Reliability is a primary department KPI and infrastructure/devops work inherently includes on-call and incident handling - a senior hire needs to understand escalation paths, tooling, and runbooks before joining rotation.

onboardingNeeds.title: Review security posture and access/governance controls
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Department mission explicitly includes security posture, and the team sits in the Platform & Security org group; DevOps engineers are typically responsible for enforcing infra-level security and compliance controls, so this is core role content, not general orientation.

onboardingNeeds.title: Shadow a deployment or infra change end-to-end
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Before leading complex workstreams independently at IC4, seeing how a real deployment/change is planned, reviewed, and executed with the current team grounds the person in actual team conventions and tooling.

onboardingNeeds.title: Meet engineering teams whose services run on the infrastructure you support
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Understand what these teams build and depend on, so infrastructure decisions account for their real deployment needs.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: core_collaboration names cross-functional partners as key; since infra/devops underpins other engineering teams' ability to ship, understanding their workloads and pain points is directly relevant, though this is an interface, not the role's own core work.

onboardingNeeds.title: Get to know your Infrastructure & DevOps teammates
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Useful context-building alongside the technical ramp-up; Process Expert's structural rule already handles the actual scheduling mechanics for this same-team group.

businessDepthNotes.reason: Infra/devops underpins all product areas (GA and beta) - worth understanding what's actually being deployed and at what lifecycle stage
Reliability and deployment frequency are named department KPIs directly tied to this role's output
